newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens plays down Usine Boel talks.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens plays down Usine Boel talks.

text.p: Dutch steel and aluminium maker Hoogovens NV said on Friday it declined to comment on Belgian newspaper reports that it was interested in buying Usines Gustave Boel in Belgium.
"We have said we want to grow internationally and follow European developments in the steel industry closely. It is possible that we look in Europe," a spokesman said.
The Dutch company had earlier issued a statement that it would not comment on statements by outside parties.
"We're not flatly denying it. So there is some room between the statements," the spokesman said.
Belgian newspapers quoted a labour union representative as saying that secret negotiations between Hoogovens and Usine Gustave Boel were coming to a conclusion.
"Usine Gustave Boel says it is thinking about the future and talking to several parties. It is also sorry that non-authorised statements have been made," the Hoogovens spokesman said.
Earlier this year Boel gave a wide mandate to consultants Morgan Stanley to investigate partnership opportunities with other steel makers.
The steel industry in the Northern Walloon region is in bad shape and Boel was included in a report commissioned by the Walloon region for restructuring the sector.
